code='''def transform(grid):
    # Take the rightmost object above the divider and stack it over the lower object.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == row[0] and v != 0 for v in row))

    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(9)]

    lower_color=grid[low[0][0]][low[0][1]]
    for r,c in b: out[5+r][5+c]=lower_color
